brief: How to validate a startup idea in 14 days — 6 concrete tests.

slots.headline: Validate Your Startup Idea in Just 14 Days With Six Hard Tests

slots.title: Run Problem Interviews
slots.body: Talk to ten potential customers about their daily frustrations. Never mention your idea; listen for pain signals and existing workarounds. If nobody complains, pivot early.

slots.title: Build a Smoke Test
slots.body: Launch a simple landing page that promises your future solution. Drive a hundred visitors and measure email signups. A sub-five-percent rate means your messaging is off or the problem is weak.

slots.title: Sell Before Building
slots.body: Offer a manual version of your product to three early adopters. This concierge MVP proves demand without code. Charge real money to validate willingness to pay.

slots.title: Force the Switch
slots.body: Ask prospects what they use today and why they would switch. Look for active dissatisfaction with current tools. No switching intent means you are a nice-to-have, not a must-have.

slots.title: Secure Pre-Orders
slots.body: Collect letters of intent or small deposits before launch. Skin in the game beats polite interest every time. If strangers pay, you have a validated market.

slots.title: Close a Paid Pilot
slots.body: Run a two-week pilot with three customers for a discounted fee. Measure actual usage and outcomes, not compliments. Revenue plus retention is the only real proof.

slots.headline: Start Your 14-Day Validation Sprint
slots.body: Download the complete checklist and validate your next idea without wasting months.
